<!-- Shared calibration-bias analysis, owned by Analyses.qmd and {{< include >}}'d into the main
     text ("A perfect model?") so the figure and its cox statistics live in one place. The including
     document's setup chunk must already define HERE and load the fn_*.R helpers (nb_exact,
     nb_treat_all, cox_calibration), data.table and ggplot2. It leaves behind `p_cal` (the plot) and
     writes data/calibration_bias_summary.csv (pooled / in-AOA / out-AOA cox intercept & slope). -->

```{r calibration-bias}
#| include: false
## Calibration is a WITHIN-AOA property. The pooled cox fit on this model looks almost perfect
## (intercept ~0.13, slope ~1.02), but it is dominated by the many far-extrapolation points; within
## the AOA the model is mildly over-extreme (slope < 1). We draw the raw-vs-recalibrated decision
## curve on the IN-AOA (in-domain) points only -- out-of-AOA there are too few presences (a handful)
## to estimate calibration or a stable curve, so it is deliberately omitted. Net benefit is
## rank-blind-proof: raw and recalibrated share every AUC, yet their curves can differ because p_t and
## p-hat share a scale. Reweighted to the same prevalence as the AOA figure.
EX <- "1arc-Iteration1-PA1:30DO:0-Seed5101"
PI <- 0.05

p <- fread(file.path(HERE, "data", "holdout_point_predictions.csv"))[model == EX & design == "spatial_mapping"]
a <- fread(file.path(HERE, "data", "holdout_point_aoa.csv"))
m <- merge(p, a[, .(model, point_id, DI, DI_thresh)], by = c("model", "point_id"))
m[, extrap := DI > DI_thresh]
ind <- m[extrap == FALSE]                        # in-AOA (in-domain) points only

pt <- seq(0.001, 0.25, by = 0.002)

## cox fit (on the RAW predictions) -- pooled vs in-AOA -- the one-number summary of the bias.
cox_of <- function(d) { cc <- cox_calibration(d$Presence, d$prob); c(intercept = cc[["cox_intercept"]], slope = cc[["cox_slope"]]) }
cox_pool <- cox_of(p[calibration == "raw"])
cox_in   <- cox_of(ind[calibration == "raw"])

raw <- ind[calibration == "raw"]; cal <- ind[calibration == "calibrated"]
curves <- rbind(
  data.table(pt = pt, nb = nb_exact(raw$Presence, raw$prob, PI, pt), strategy = "SDM — raw (as output)"),
  data.table(pt = pt, nb = nb_exact(cal$Presence, cal$prob, PI, pt), strategy = "SDM — recalibrated"),
  data.table(pt = pt, nb = nb_treat_all(PI, pt),                     strategy = "Survey all (treat-all)"),
  data.table(pt = pt, nb = 0,                                        strategy = "Survey none (treat-none)"))
lv <- c("SDM — raw (as output)", "SDM — recalibrated", "Survey all (treat-all)", "Survey none (treat-none)")
curves[, strategy := factor(strategy, levels = lv)]
is_ref <- grepl("treat", curves$strategy)

p_cal <- ggplot(mapping = aes(pt, nb, colour = strategy)) +
  geom_line(data = curves[is_ref],  aes(linetype = strategy), linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_line(data = curves[!is_ref], linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.005, y = PI * 1.05, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, colour = "grey25",
           label = sprintf("in-AOA cox intercept %.2f\nin-AOA cox slope %.2f", cox_in[["intercept"]], cox_in[["slope"]])) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("SDM — raw (as output)" = cda_cols[["summary"]], "SDM — recalibrated" = cda_cols[["naive"]],
                                 "Survey all (treat-all)" = cda_cols[["treat_all"]], "Survey none (treat-none)" = cda_cols[["treat_none"]]), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_reference() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.03, PI * 1.08)) +
  labs(x = expression("Threshold probability  " * p[t]), y = "Net benefit",
       title = sprintf("Calibration within the AOA: raw vs recalibrated (prevalence %.1f%%)", 100 * PI),
       subtitle = sprintf("Pooled the model looks calibrated (slope %.2f); in-domain it is over-extreme (slope %.2f).",
                          cox_pool[["slope"]], cox_in[["slope"]])) +
  theme_cda()
ggsave(file.path(HERE, "figures", "dca_calibration.png"), p_cal, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 150)

## stash the cox summary so the main .Rmd (knitr, no shared env) can read it like patch_summary.
out <- data.table(
  prevalence     = PI,
  cox_int_pool   = cox_pool[["intercept"]], cox_slope_pool = cox_pool[["slope"]],
  cox_int_in     = cox_in[["intercept"]],   cox_slope_in   = cox_in[["slope"]])
fwrite(out, file.path(HERE, "data", "calibration_bias_summary.csv"))
```
